newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 2.9 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Dewan Salman Fibre gained 0.80 rupees, or 2.9 percent, to 28.40 by the midsession on Monday on expectations that manufacturers will increase polyester staple fibre (PSF) prices next month, dealers said.
Turnover of 290,000 shares was recorded on the Karachi exchange by the midsession.
"People expect that polyester fibre manufacturers will increase polyester fibre prices at their quarterly meeting next month," dealer Ather Raouf of Carr Mashriq said.
Dealer Sajjad Mankani said last week's devaluation of the rupee by 7.86 percent against the dollar had made imported fibre costlier, which would help local manufacturers in the long run.
But Raouf said a price increase would not have much impact on the earnings of PSF manufacturers as the import price of raw material had also increased due to the devaluation.
